title: Can Occupational Therapy help improve my child’s understanding and use of non-verbal communication?
metaTitle: Improving Non-Verbal Communication Skills in Children through Occupational Therapy
description: Learn how occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms can help improve a child's understanding and use of non-verbal communication skills. Interpreting body language, facial expressions, and more.
html: Absolutely, our occupational therapists can assist in improving non-verbal communication skills, such as interpreting body language and facial expressions, understanding personal space and using appropriate gestures, which are important for social interactions.
